architecture_decisions: {Architecture Decision: Selective Exact Competition for Wave 6 Candidate-competition Layer}
work_items: {Work Item: Establish Wave 6 Candidate-competition Layer for Exact Competition Context}
validations: {Validation: Deterministic Validation and Independent Evaluation for Exact Competition Context}

AC-01: validate protected requirement — Every competition decision binds canonical Project ID, Engineering Run ID, exact Work Specification ID/revision/digest, stable acceptance IDs, exact S2/S3/S4 dependency identity where applicable and exact competition-policy ID/version/digest. Malformed, duplicate, stale, mismatched or cross-Project identity fails closed.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — Server-owned policy invokes competition only when admitted evidence justifies additional alternatives. Tests prove multiple available agents/candidates alone do not force competition, missing economic/risk evidence is not treated as free competition, and trigger dispositions are deterministic and bounded.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Each candidate is provenance-bound to one exact Project/run/spec/acceptance set, producer identity, candidate/source-lineage digest, protected-validation evidence and S3 evaluation evidence. Duplicate/mismatched/conflicting candidate identities fail closed and separate display IDs cannot make one lineage appear as independent alternatives.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Candidates failing mandatory deterministic validation or S3 independence/policy requirements are excluded before quality/economic comparison. Tests prove cheaper/faster or agent/evaluator-preferred failed candidates cannot re-enter or win.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Competition binds exact policy ID/version/digest covering trigger rules, candidate/evidence requirements, quality floors, comparison order/weights, candidate/synthesis/cost/time/attempt/no-progress bounds, tie-breaking, fallback and HUMAN_REQUIRED behavior. Agent/source/model content cannot modify policy or acceptance criteria.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — The same exact eligible candidate/evidence set produces the same comparison components, disposition, supported-candidate identity and fingerprint. Ties use explicit server-owned stable identity rules, never arrival order, majority vote or model preference.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — S4 routing/cost/time/retry/intervention evidence may influence whether competition is justified and permitted post-eligibility utility/ties only. Tests prove economic advantage cannot override protected failure, evaluator-policy failure, unresolved HUMAN_REQUIRED or quality floors.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — A synthesis disposition emits only a bounded synthesis request bound to exact parent evidence and target acceptance gaps. The resulting implementation must have a new candidate/attempt/lineage identity and cannot inherit parent deterministic validation or S3 evaluation status.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — A synthesized candidate is ineligible until fresh exact-lineage protected BUILD/TEST/VERIFY and fresh policy-valid independent evaluation bind the new candidate. Tests prove stale/parent validation/evaluation evidence cannot satisfy the synthesized candidate.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Candidate count, competition rounds, extra attempts, synthesis attempts/parents, economic budget class, evidence size and no-progress behavior are bounded. Exhaustion terminates explicitly without unbounded agents/candidates, threshold weakening or cross-Project source/evidence access.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — Exact replay is duplicate-safe; candidate/policy/evidence drift produces a new fingerprint; conflicting records fail closed. Safe serialization excludes secrets/source bytes/raw provider payloads/prompts/hidden reasoning/arbitrary URLs/commands and grants no capability, provider/spending, source acceptance, Engineering Run transition, merge/deploy, approval or REVIEW authority.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Focused S5 tests plus relevant accepted S1 agent, S2 team, S3 evaluation, S4 routing/economic, source-lineage, protected validation/evaluation, provider and bounded-autonomy regressions remain green. `P2-V0.19.5` has stable acceptance IDs and authentic DSPy evidence before semantic implementation; temporary DSPy workflow changes are restored byte-for-byte; exact-head Workstream Spec Validation, Bounded Autonomy Pilot and P2 CI pass; PR targets the Wave 6 integration branch and worker stops `READY FOR INTEGRATION` with no merge/deploy.
risks: {Risk: Deterministic correctness and independent evaluation precede comparison, with S4 economics not overriding correctness}
